title: Breda — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Breda.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Precision." Specialty tier. Breda makes Italian-built refrigeration and cooking appliances for the North American market. Focused on built-in and column formats with European styling.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: European-style built-in kitchen designs. Italian brand enthusiasts.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Breda:

• Italian-made built-in appliances

• European column refrigeration

• Distinctive Italian design

• Growing North American presence

• Competitive with established European brands
